import numpy as np
import openmdao.api as om
from openmdao.test_suite.components.sellar import SellarDerivatives
model = SellarDerivatives()
model.nonlinear_solver = om.NonlinearBlockGS()
prob = om.Problem(model)
prob.driver = om.ScipyOptimizeDriver()
prob.driver.options['optimizer'] = 'SLSQP'
model.add_design_var('z', lower=np.array([-10.0, 0.0]), upper=np.array([10.0, 10.0]), scaler=2.0)
model.add_objective('obj', scaler=0.1)
model.add_constraint('con1', upper=1.0, scaler=7.0)
prob.setup()
prob.run_driver()
def read_vars():
    return prob.list_driver_vars(driver_scaling=False,
        desvar_opts=['lower', 'upper', 'scaler', 'adder'],
        cons_opts=['lower', 'upper', 'scaler', 'adder'],
        objs_opts=['scaler', 'adder'])
info1 = read_vars()
info2 = read_vars()
u1 = info1['design_vars'][0][1]['upper']
u2 = info2['design_vars'][0][1]['upper']
print('bounds_stable', list(u1), list(u2))
assert list(u1) == list(u2) == [10.0, 10.0], 'bounds drifted across reads'
print('meta_identity', info1['design_vars'][0][1] is prob.driver._designvars['z'])
assert info1['design_vars'][0][1] is not prob.driver._designvars['z'], 'read shares internal meta'
print('f2_read_isolation', True)
